candidates.description: This feature vector activates on common linguistic suffixes and stems frequently found in Romance languages like Italian and Spanish.
This feature vector represents Italian words and terms related to capability, possibility, and descriptions of importance or difficulty.
This vector represents common Italian adverbial, pronominal, and modal grammatical particles.
This feature vector is related to subwords, prefixes, and variations centered around the character sequence "fl" and the word "flush".
This vector represents common suffixes and root endings found in Latin-derived and Romance-language adjectives and nouns.
This feature activates on adjectives describing frequency, speed, likelihood, or manner of occurrence.
This feature vector is related to common Italian noun and adjective suffixes or morphological endings.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Italian place name and municipality of Brescia.
These tokens represent contracted or inflected forms of definite articles and prepositions in Romance languages like Italian and French.
This vector represents Italian adverbs of manner, time, and degree, many of which share the common suffix "-mente".
